pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal to sub-circular geometries with moderately sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries. Spatial area of patches is larger on the shoulder and mid-flank, becoming smaller and more fragmented toward the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned interstitial pathways form a continuous topological graph with multiple tri-point junction nodes. Corridor width is relatively uniform throughout the visible flank, with minor narrowing between the largest patches on the shoulder.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a dark brown 1D silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder with a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated pattern against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark-colored avian subject (oxpecker) is perched on the upper neck, creating a localized silhouette disruption and textural anomaly.
